component.name: AppReestr
component.summary: See every installed application and remove it safely
Все установленные программы и их безопасное удаление

description.p: AppReestr shows the applications installed on an Arch Linux system in one list, like “Installed apps” in Windows: only programs you use, not libraries and system plumbing.

ul.li: Packages from the official repositories and the AUR, Flatpak, AppImage, Snap and manual installs
Where each program came from, when and how it was installed, and what it brought along
Safe removal with the standard tools; the system and the desktop are protected
Optional removal of settings and caches into the trash

description.p: AppReestr показывает установленные в Arch Linux программы одним списком, как «Установленные приложения» в Windows: только то, чем пользуется человек.
